AC-3: state plainly whether this document's conclusion is sufficient to formally freeze pcp_storage_engine_decision, or what specifically is still missing before a freeze (e.g. a PO DECIDE episode, given UI2.0's own C-1..C-4 are still open and may bear on this).
AC-4: update backlog.json's pcp_storage_engine_decision note to record this document's conclusion, without marking the item done unless AC-3 concludes it's genuinely freezable now.

entries.subject: PCP storage-engine decision document produced, merged (PR #147); not yet freezable
entries.text:
Produced docs/design/PCP_STORAGE_ENGINE_DECISION.md checking UI2_0_ARCHITECTURE_REQUIREMENTS.md's X-2 recommendation (PostgreSQL production engine; SQLite stays local; CAS/recovery blobs stay on volume) against every criterion PRODUCT_CONTROL_PLANE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 10 recorded -- all ten addressed, nine map soundly and are grounded in existing code (utils/evidence_backend.py's seven concerns, PRIVACY_AND_DATA_HANDLING.md's Distributed evidence store section), one (backup/recovery vs recovery_offhost_key_custody) answers a narrower question than section 10 asked and needs an explicit PO answer.

Conclusion (AC-3): X-2's direction is a sound, well-evidenced standing recommendation, but NOT sufficient to freeze pcp_storage_engine now. Three reasons, all already on record rather than newly invented: (1) X-2 itself disclaims freeze authority -- it lives inside UI2_0_ARCHITECTURE_REQUIREMENTS.md, whose own Status line says DRAFT, DO NOT FREEZE without the C-1..C-4 decisions; (2) the recorded decide_by gate for this exact item (project/roadmap.json: PCP.5 contract freeze / DEV.4.6 migrations and database roles) has not been reached; (3) UI2.0's own open C-1/C-4 bear on whether/when a production multi-user engine is even needed, not just which one. What it would take to freeze: a PO DECIDE episode closing the off-host-custody gap, sequencing against DEV.4.6, timed at or after C-1/C-4 resolve.

project/backlog.json's pcp_storage_engine_decision note updated to record this conclusion; item left status=planned, not marked done, per AC-4.

This is a genuine PO-only decision (AC-5) -- not a blocking question, the movement itself completed and merged per the standing relay#13 self-merge authorization (design-only gate: git diff --check clean, repository privacy gate showed the same 5 pre-existing findings before and after this change via stash-diff comparison -- zero new findings, CI validate check green, full-regression correctly skipped for a docs-only diff). PO reviews the conclusion and decides whether/when to run the DECIDE episode -- nothing here is blocked on that review, it is just not itself a freeze.
